versions.name: Firelands Scout Reservation

features.note: Water activities on the reservation's lake and expanded pond.
Camp Alaska, a winter challenge in which participants backpack their gear in and sleep out in a Scout-made site.
Cabins at Camp Avery Hand sleeping four to thirty-two people.
High ropes course at Camp Wyandot.
A 23-acre lake at Camp Wyandot with an island joined by a peninsula.

versions.summary: Lake Erie Council's home base for Cub Scout and Webelos resident camps, hosting overnight adventure sessions at Camp Wyandot in Wakeman, Ohio.

provenance.notes: Imported from camp-finder; raw description and sessions dropped (operational data stays at the council site). verified_at is camp-finder's own source-confirmation date; imported_at is when open-scout-api ingested it. The evergreen summary is original prose regenerated from that description, excluding dates/fees/schedules. camp_type classified from program_types. Website repaired 2026-07-25: the stored link was a registration portal (https://scoutingevent.com/440-smores2026); replaced with the council's own camp page, found by tools/find_camp_pages.py and confirmed to name the camp. Features surveyed 2026-07-25 against the council's own camp page (that page is explicitly not an exhaustive activity list, so absence of a code is not evidence of absence).
